survey: A 4-4-0-style steam locomotive with a coal tender, seen in three-quarter front view from a little above the deck. The front (red buffer beam, round smokebox door, cowcatcher) faces down-left toward the viewer. The right side (red wheels, rods, cylinder) runs back toward a vanishing point on the right, near the desert horizon. Boiler: a horizontal cylinder resting on a flat black running-board deck. Its front disc is a slightly upright ellipse, which fits a front face turned about 40° from the camera. Smokestack: rises from the top front of the boiler; its top rim is seen almost edge-on, close to eye level. Headlight: mounted on the side of the stack base, lens facing front-left. Steam dome and bell: sit on the boiler top and are seen from the side. Cab: sits at the back of the deck. Its roof slab is near eye level, so its edges stay almost horizontal, which fits. The front face has a porthole and the side has open window bars. Tender: behind the cab, with coal heaped on top. Deck: its side edge, the rails and the line of wheels all rise to the right toward the same vanishing point. The buffer beam, the bottom bar of the cowcatcher and the sleepers run along the other, front-facing direction. Wheels: a small leading wheel, three large drivers and two small trailing wheels. All are upright ellipses with similar narrowness, get smaller as they recede, and sit on the near rail. Rods: the coupling rod links the driver hubs parallel to the track, and the main rod runs from the cylinder to a crank pin. Contact: the wheels rest on the near rail. The cowcatcher hangs over the track between the rails, and the track gauge roughly matches the width of the front.
